verdict.rationale: Puzzle's docs show several natural-language interfaces. Users can ask questions about their business in plain English. Accounting AI runs prompts on top of the general ledger. Tasks can be described once and then done automatically. The Puzzle MCP lets users work with financial data through natural conversation in Claude. Most of this evidence covers querying or reading data and narrow AI-assisted tasks, not broad operation of the product through natural-language commands. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core write actions across the product (posting entries, reconciling, invoicing via commands), documented scope and limits of what the MCP can perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
